shared_or_similar_visual_information: The numerical notation 2 in both images.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The variable x is squared; 2 is its exponent. Right image: The expression x−2 is squared; 2 is the exponent.
Rationales: Both selected superscripts are exponent 2 and denote squaring of their respective bases. The bases x and x−2 need not be equal.
